headline: On 3 days of Ethereum (5.44M transactions), naive deposit-address reuse merged 198 pairs of addresses from two different exchanges, none caused by poisoning, sweepers or fee services; the same-sender rule merged 359, and 60% of those came only through poisoning transfers.
